REVISE

1. Question "Is every claim grounded?" fails at note 4, the edge row `.claude/skills/Author-Artifact/SKILL.md`, and the R6 and "Deliberately different" rows (§4). The page says the guard's `lower()` case-folds paths and "must fold the list too". In `scripts/agent-hook.sh:91-95`, `lower()` folds only when `git config core.ignorecase` is true. Otherwise it returns the string unchanged. The Rust `protected()` sketch never folds at all. So on a case-insensitive checkout the guard and the Rust side can disagree, and on a case-sensitive one `Author-Artifact` is a different folder. The page also admits it has not checked how either host treats skill names. A rewrite must state the `core.ignorecase` condition, say whether Rust and the guard diverge on `Author-Artifact`, and fix the "case-folded by `lower()`" wording in §4.

2. Fixed check "cited" (and the provenance of "compiled in a scratch copy") fails in pair A and the §5 edge table. The `.agents/skills/investigate/SKILL.md` and `docs/skills/investigate.md` rows show `forces_standard` going `true → false` "by naming the two pointers instead of the folder". The sketch code only changes `protected()` in transitions.rs. The size.rs `CEREMONY` change that produces those flips is never shown, so a reader cannot check those rows against the sketch. A rewrite must add the `CEREMONY` edit to pair A or B, labelled as a sketch, or drop the claim.
